title: Invisible Items
description: Removes the model of any held item. In other words, it becomes invisible.
body:
Removes the item model of anything held. In other words, it makes every item invisible.

Watch the video about it [here](https://youtu.be/D1x28KgqeJQ)

I do not plan on updating this datapack.

Please credit me if you use this datapack in any sort of public or profitable manner.
